About.title: Our Mission & Story
About.subtitle: Empowering the engine of India's economy: One MSME at a time.
About.visionP1: Founded with a single mission: to eliminate the regulatory and technological barriers that hold back India's micro-entrepreneurs. We believe that professional business tools, compliance, and advanced AI should not be locked behind high consultancy fees or complex enterprise software.
About.visionP2: At MSME 360, we are building a founder-first infrastructure that guides you from your first Udyam registration to your first AI-driven revenue forecast—all with zero upfront cost.

founderFirst.title: Founder-First
founderFirst.desc: Everything we build is designed for the person on the ground. Simple, mobile-first, and results-driven.

zeroFee.title: Zero-Fee Access
zeroFee.desc: We eliminate the 'compliance tax'. Our core enablement platform is free forever for small founders.

aiDemocratization.title: AI Democratization
aiDemocratization.desc: We bring specialized AI microservices out of reach for most small businesses right to your dashboard.

communityScale.title: Community Scale
communityScale.desc: You are not building alone. Connect with 100,000+ peers and veterans in our ecosystem.
